# Salford

Salford is a global titanium dioxide (TiO₂) importer and supplier providing high-quality titanium dioxide solutions to industrial manufacturers, importer and businesses worldwide. Salford supplies multiple TiO₂ grades for applications including paints and coatings, plastics and polymers, laminates, and other industrial applications. The company focuses on reliable sourcing, consistent product quality, stable supply, flexible volumes, and global delivery.

## Titanium Dioxide Applications
* [Titanium Dioxide for Plastics](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): TiO₂ solutions for plastics, masterbatch, polymers, and applications requiring whiteness, opacity, and UV resistance.
* [Titanium Dioxide for Laminates](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-laminates): TiO₂ solutions for decorative laminates and films requiring whiteness, smoothness, gloss, and light stability.
* [Titanium Dioxide for Coatings](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): TiO₂ solutions for architectural, industrial, automotive, powder, waterborne, coil, and other coating applications.

## Titanium Dioxide Solutions for Plastics
* [Titanium Dioxide Solutions for Plastics] (https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Salford provides titanium dioxide (TiO₂) pigments for plastics and polymer applications, supporting requirements for whiteness, brightness, opacity, UV protection, dispersion, color stability, and processing performance. TiO₂ grades can be selected according to resin type, processing conditions, and the performance requirements of the finished plastic product.

### Salford TiO₂ Grades for Plastics
* [SALFORD 201](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Universal rutile titanium dioxide pigment manufactured by the chloride process, offering a warm-white tone, high lacing resistance, and stability for high-temperature applications. Suitable for high-temperature cast and extrusion coating films, extrusion-coated paper, and high-quality color masterbatch.
* [SALFORD 250](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): High-performance rutile titanium dioxide pigment providing chemical stability, dispersion, and brightness for high-gloss plastic and film applications. Suitable for automotive ABS parts, thermoplastic masterbatches, UV-stable appliance applications, and high-performance BOPP films.
* [SALFORD 260](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment designed for weathering resistance, gloss retention, and UV protection. Suitable for outdoor building products, stadium seats, patio furniture, and automotive body panels.
* [SALFORD 269](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Blue-tinted rutile titanium dioxide pigment offering high brightness, good dispersibility, and easy processing for non-durable indoor plastic applications. Suitable for polyolefin masterbatch, styrenics, interior rigid PVC, ABS, flexible PVC, and plastisols.
* [SALFORD 280](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Multi-purpose blue-tint rutile titanium dioxide pigment providing brightness, opacity, and durability across PVC and plastic applications. Suitable for polyolefin masterbatch, styrenics, ABS, flexible PVC, and plastisols.
* [SALFORD 288](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment designed for opacity, tint strength, and brightness. Suitable for masterbatches, compounds, PVC films, polystyrene and copolymers, and engineering plastics.
* [SALFORD 626](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-plastics): Chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with a neutral tint, high outdoor durability, brightness, and opacity. Suitable for PVC profiles and sidings, engineering plastics, flexible PVC, plasticizer pastes, liquid colours, polystyrene, and copolymers.

## Salford TiO₂ Grades for Laminates
* [Titanium Dioxide Solutions for Laminates](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-laminates): Salford provides titanium dioxide (TiO₂) solutions for laminate applications, supporting brilliant whiteness, high opacity, light stability, color retention, smooth processing, and consistent visual quality across décor papers, decorative foils, flooring, furniture, and printed laminates.

### Salford TiO₂ Product Grade for Laminates
* [SALFORD 296+](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-laminates): A versatile, high-brightness rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced using the chloride process. SALFORD 296+ is suitable for laminate applications requiring high brightness, opacity, color retention, and light stability.

## Titanium Dioxide Solutions for Paints & Coatings
* [Titanium Dioxide Solutions for Paints & Coatings](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): Salford provides titanium dioxide (TiO₂) solutions for architectural, industrial, automotive, powder, waterborne, coil, and other coating applications. Salford's TiO₂ grades are designed to provide opacity, brightness, whiteness, UV stability, gloss, durability, color retention, and effective dispersion.

### Salford TiO₂ Grades for Paints & Coatings
* [SALFORD 618](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): Fine, interior-grade rutile titanium dioxide pigment offering good gloss, high hiding power, and enhanced durability for indoor paints and coatings. Applications include interior industrial coatings, powder coatings, coil coatings, container coatings, electrodeposition coatings, and interior architectural coatings.
* [SALFORD 620](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): Blue-tint, sulphate-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment providing high gloss, excellent opacity, and easy dispersion. Applications include industrial coatings, powder coatings, and external and internal architectural coatings.
* [SALFORD 628](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): Rutile titanium dioxide pigment offering excellent brightness, high tint strength, and superior opacity with a neutral tint. Applications listed by Salford include powder coatings, white and tinted automotive finishes, waterborne paints, screen and digital printing inks, quartz and stone, coil coating, and UV-cured finishes.
* [SALFORD 660](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): Rutile titanium dioxide pigment providing exceptional durability, chalk resistance, UV resistance, and color retention. Applications include automotive OEM topcoats and refinish coatings, high-durability exterior coil coatings, aerospace coatings, powder coatings, and specialty coatings requiring superior chalk resistance.
* [SALFORD 686](https://salfordworld.com/tio2-for-coatings): High-gloss, durable rutile titanium dioxide pigment offering excellent dispersibility. Applications include architectural and industrial paints, screen and digital printing inks, waterborne paints, white automotive finishes, quartz and stone, coil coating, and UV-cured finishes.
